summary: Played the three mini games (Play, start card, W, run, Stop) and watched the follow camera in the sandbox, with screenshots. Berry race start view, HUDs and the cutting follow camera look right; the four suite failures stay as before and were not re-run alone. Note: world/tests files starting with '_' are NOT loaded by live_tests (the skill says they are), so my scratch file is explore45.jl.

failures.what: Hide and seek and Firefly catch: on the start card Sprout is hard to see. The card covers the middle of the view and the view is a low shot with a big tree on the right; only a faint shape shows behind the card. The berry race start view (Sprout and rivals below the card) is fine.
failures.steps: Mini game menu: Hide and seek (or Firefly catch), Play, look at the view before pressing W.
failures.expected: As in the berry race: the player's creature is seen below the card.
failures.actual: The card and the foliage fill the view; Sprout is not recognisable until W. I could not confirm it by measurement (my projection test was unreliable and I removed it), so this is from the screenshots only.

failures.what: Berry race while running: the key hint bar (W A S D Shift R) sits on top of the rivals' name tags (Wibbles, Cumulus) at the bottom edge.
failures.steps: Play the berry race, press W for 1.5 s, look at the bottom of the 3D view.
failures.expected: Hints do not hide names of creatures.
failures.actual: 'Wibbles' and 'Cumulus' labels are partly under the W and R keys.

failures.what: Suite failure (not re-run alone): Firefly catch end-card test, state stays 'playing' with score 0 after 8 catches.
failures.steps: Host suite, test 'Firefly catch: catching all ends with the end card...'.
failures.expected: Round ends with the end card.

failures.what: Suite failure (not re-run alone): Cairn fetch test, no stone in 60 s (critter wanders 9.2 m away).
failures.steps: Host suite, test 'Cairn: a critter fetches a pebble...'.

failures.what: Suite failure (not re-run alone): parade of three at the lantern forms no dance ring; the followers left for fishing, flowers and a chat.
failures.expected: Dance ring with Sprout in the middle.

failures.what: Suite failure (not re-run alone): follow camera view blocked (obstruction 0.58, goal view 0.0, eye 3.49 m).
failures.steps: Host suite, test 'The follow camera has a clear view of its creature'.

tests_added: Berry race: W lifts the camera from the low start view to the chase view, Stop ends it
Hide and seek and Firefly catch: Play shows the start card, W starts with a HUD, Stop ends each
Follow camera: watching alone for 12 s keeps a creature name tag and the game running
